lines.text: Two people drag one shape at once. Why doesn't the file break?
Your drag shows on your screen instantly, before the server answers.
Then every edit goes to the server, which puts them in one order.
Same property? The last value the server gets wins, everywhere.
Different properties, like position and color? Both survive.
[Figma](/fˈɪɡmə/) says that's not a true CRDT: one server orders every change.
